valle-guadalupe.name: Valle de Guadalupe
valle-guadalupe.summary: Baja's warmth produces ripe, robust wines, while Pacific breezes can moderate the heat.

cabernet-sauvignon.expect: Ripe and robust, with dark fruit, generous body and warm-climate richness.

tempranillo.expect: Bold Tempranillo with ripe black fruit, spice and generous alcohol.

syrah.expect: Ripe, peppery and full-bodied, with dark fruit and smoky spice.

chenin-blanc.expect: Richer and broader than Loire Chenin, with ripe orchard fruit and softer acidity.

black-sea-ukraine.name: Black Sea / Odesa
black-sea-ukraine.summary: Ukraine's main southern wine zone combines Black Sea influence, drought-prone steppes and broad varietal diversity.

cabernet-sauvignon.expect: Full-bodied and dark-fruited, with savory herbal detail from a warm Black Sea climate.

merlot.expect: Ripe plum and black cherry with a savory, structured edge.

sauvignon-blanc.expect: Fresh and aromatic, with citrus, herbs and lively acidity.

odesa-black.expect: Very dark and intense, with blackberry, mint and velvety, jammy fruit.

saperavi.expect: Deeply colored and structured, with dark fruit, acidity and savory spice.

zakarpattia.name: Zakarpattia
zakarpattia.summary: Carpathian shelter and sunny slopes favor fresh whites and increasingly successful reds.

riesling.expect: Fresh and aromatic, with citrus, orchard fruit and a cool-climate profile.

thracian-valley.name: Thracian Valley
thracian-valley.summary: Southern Bulgaria is known for ripe reds, including local Mavrud alongside international varieties.

mavrud.expect: Sturdy and dark-fruited, with firm tannin, herbs and tobacco-like complexity.

merlot.expect: Ripe, generous Merlot with dark fruit and warm-climate richness.

chardonnay.expect: Round and ripe, with orchard fruit and moderate acidity.

struma-valley.name: Struma Valley / Melnik
struma-valley.summary: Southwestern Bulgaria's warm valley is the classic home of Melnik, capable of savory, ageworthy reds.

melnik.expect: Savory and spicy, with red-black fruit, tobacco and a Rhône-like structural feel.

krasnodar.name: Krasnodar / Kuban
krasnodar.summary: Southern Russia's main wine zone grows international varieties and Saperavi across varied Black Sea and Kuban terroirs.

cabernet-sauvignon.expect: Dark-fruited and savory, with cassis, dried plum and herbal-pepper detail.

saperavi.expect: Deeply colored, firm and savory, with dark fruit, pronounced structure and spice.

riesling.expect: Fresh and aromatic, with citrus and orchard fruit in a warmer southern expression.
